title: Matam e akbar
body:
Matam e akbar
(Haye haye Ali Akbar)..(4)
HUSSAIN... HUSSAIN
Lashaye Akbar jo laye khaymo me
Phuphi ne seena o sar peet kar kiya nauha
Kohraam mach gaya..
(Ya HUSSAIN )..(6)
Haan..
<<MINI>>
(khaimo'n me shor matam e Akbar ka hota hai)..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
(1)
(ZAINAB yeh bain karti thi Akbar ki laashe par)..(2)
Afsos tere............haye
Afsos tere laashe par sehra sajaya hai

(2)
